## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: risk and cycle ratios are flat (VXX (1W: +1.56% | 1M: -6.03%) ↑ rising but 1M softer → RECOVERY; SPY (1W: -0.95% | 1M: +0.41%) → flat CORRECTION and TLT (1W: -0.10% | 1M: -2.47%) → flat BELOW TREND), and credit signals mixed (HYG (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +0.40%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: +0.18% | 1M: -1.14%) RECOVERY).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Commodities/energy rally driving market microstructure: UGA (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +20.44%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +13.41%) ABOVE TREND. Credit/volatility are neutral-to-mixed with HYG/LQD modestly positive and VXX (1W: +1.56% | 1M: -6.03%) ↑ rising on the week.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral: SPY/TLT shows no decisive stocks-vs-bonds tilt (SPY (1W: -0.95% | 1M: +0.41%) CORRECTION, TLT (1W: -0.10% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND). Dollar and curve flagged neutral in the barometer, so overall financial conditions neither tightening nor easing materially.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND and sector breadth shows Energy positive. Technology lagging: XLK (1W: -3.07% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND; style: Value/energy over Growth.

5. US vs Global?
US mixed: SPY (1W: -0.95% | 1M: +0.41%) CORRECTION while China outperforms: FXI (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +4.13%) ABOVE TREND; EM weaker: EEM (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -7.29%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed speculation: IBIT (1W: +4.74% | 1M: +1.46%) ABOVE TREND shows crypto ETF demand while ARKK (1W: -4.21% | 1M: -4.51%) BELOW TREND and MTUM (1W: -3.81% | 1M: -7.81%) BELOW TREND reflect momentum/innovation weakness.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodity strength concentrated in oil and wheat: USO (1W: +6.55% | 1M: +9.87%) ABOVE TREND, WEAT (1W: +5.62% | 1M: +7.72%) ABOVE TREND; CPER (1W: +1.27% | 1M: -0.57%) RECOVERY for copper, while gold GLD (1W: +0.13% | 1M: -5.40%) RECOVERY amid profit taking.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy clear leader: XLE (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +13.41%) ABOVE TREND and UGA (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +20.44%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: -0.77% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: Energy (XLE (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND) and China (FXI (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +4.13%) ABOVE TREND) show consistent strength. Divergence: SPY (1W: -0.95% | 1M: +0.41%) CORRECTION vs XLK (1W: -3.07% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND and QQQ (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -3.55%) BELOW TREND — rotational fractures inside a neutral market.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to energy and select commodity plays (XLE (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +13.41%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor China/EM names like FXI (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +4.13%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to large-cap tech (XLK (1W: -3.07% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND) and momentum ETFs showing weakness.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND and Commodities (BNO (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +13.41%) ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Technology XLK (1W: -3.07% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND and Semis SOXX (1W: -5.32% | 1M: -12.60%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Oil (UGA (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +20.44%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +6.55% | 1M: +9.87%) ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -0.77% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND and silver SLV (1W: -2.26% | 1M: -15.89%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Watch VXX (1W: +1.56% | 1M: -6.03%) RECOVERY near 20 for volatility signals, HYG (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +0.40%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: +0.18% | 1M: -1.14%) RECOVERY for credit health, and the XLK (1W: -3.07% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND / XLF (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +4.04%) CORRECTION spread as a growth-vs-value pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive, with mixed risk/cycle ratios supporting a flat regime. Energy and commodities showing strength (XLE, BNO, UGA), while Tech (XLK, QQQ) is weak — monitor SPY/XLK divergence and VXX for shifts.
